purpose: Distinguish fixed pretrained shared features from jointly updated shared prefix

selection_ablation_reason: legacy J histories show mean-checkpoint selection can lower emotion validation; taskwise maxima are not deployable with changing shared weights, but are composable with an unchanged frozen prefix
scope: public downstream development; no new pretraining or official evaluation
